new.title: New agent
new.subtitle: An agent is the AI program you want to test, plus the model it uses. Pick a template, name it, choose a model. You can change everything later.
new.name: Agent name
new.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Saved as agents/<name>.yaml.
new.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.
new.modelHelp: The AI model this agent uses by default. A comparison can still swap it.
new.notesPlaceholder: What this agent is for. Saved as a note at the top of its settings file.
new.pickFirst: Pick a template on the left to continue.
new.empty: This server has no agent templates. Upload your agent's folder as a zip instead.
new.memberOnly: Only members can create agents. Ask an org admin.
new.ownModel: This agent picks its own model. Evaluations report it as the agent's own model.

frameworkHint.langgraph: LangGraph: add a small /run route that calls graph.invoke({"messages": [...]}) and returns {status, final_message}.
frameworkHint.crewai: CrewAI: add a /run route that calls crew.kickoff(inputs={"task": instruction}) and returns {status, final_message}.
frameworkHint.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK: add a /run route that awaits Runner.run(agent, instruction) and returns {status, final_message: result.final_output}.
frameworkHint.custom: Your server answers POST on the run path with {status: "completed", final_message: "..."}.

test.help: Sends one real sample task to your endpoint, with the auth and signature above, and shows the answer. Takes up to 2 minutes.
test.okNoMatch: Your endpoint answered in {{ms}} ms (not with READY, which is fine for a task agent)

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Every save of this agent's settings is a version. Benchmark a version to compare it with another.
versions.empty: No versions yet. Save the settings or press Save as new version.
versions.first: First version, nothing to compare with.

reportCard.empty: No report card yet for this version and model. Run an evaluation to get one.
reportCard.loadError: Could not load the report card

config.loadError: Could not load this agent's config
config.notFound: This agent has no settings file yet (agents/{{id}}.yaml).
config.invalidFile: The settings file has an error, so the form is turned off. Fix it in the YAML view.
config.conflict: Someone else changed this file. Reload to see their version, then apply your edit again.
